Change c0371. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): I was alone; none were near me to dissipate the gloom, and relieve me from the sickening oppression of the most terrible reveries.

1818 text: Several hours past, and I remained near my window gazing on the sea; it was almost motionless, for the winds were hushed, and all nature reposed under the eye of the quiet moon.

1831 text: Several hours passed, and I remained near my window gazing on the sea; it was almost motionless, for the winds were hushed, and all nature reposed under the eye of the quiet moon.

Diff: Several hours [-past-] {+passed+} , and I remained near my window gazing on the sea; it was almost motionless, for the winds were hushed, and all nature reposed under the eye of the quiet moon.

Context after (unchanged): A few fishing vessels alone specked the water, and now and then the gentle breeze wafted the sound of voices, as the fishermen called to one another.

result.rationale: Changes 'past' to 'passed', the standard past-tense form of the verb 'to pass' in 'Several hours passed'; a grammatical correction with no change in meaning or events.
